E-field analysis stroke tDCS

Diego Arias

2026-09-15

Stats analyses

Fixed effects: Modality (T1 or T1+T2), Freesurfer (Yes or No), Lesion Mask (Yes or No)

Random effects: Subjects

Results: Statistically significant effects for Freesurfer and Lesion Mask, no interactions.

1 - Avg. E-field magnitude

a) Linear mixed-effect model

mod1 <- lmer(avg_roi_E_magn ~
               #Fixed Effects
               modality*FS*LE +
               #Random Effects
               (1|subID),
               #Define the data:
               data=sub_data_all.df, REML = TRUE)

summary(mod1)
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method [
## lmerModLmerTest]
## Formula: avg_roi_E_magn ~ modality * FS * LE + (1 | subID)
##    Data: sub_data_all.df
## 
## REML criterion at convergence: -1030.5
## 
## Scaled residuals: 
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -3.4797 -0.5098 -0.0274  0.4751  3.8890 
## 
## Random effects:
##  Groups   Name        Variance  Std.Dev.
##  subID    (Intercept) 0.0004817 0.02195 
##  Residual             0.0003843 0.01960 
## Number of obs: 232, groups:  subID, 30
## 
## Fixed effects:
##                           Estimate Std. Error         df t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)               0.142381   0.005373  72.056059  26.500  < 2e-16 ***
## modalityt1+t2            -0.005666   0.005062 194.818632  -1.119   0.2644    
## FSon                     -0.032894   0.005114 195.072597  -6.432 9.52e-10 ***
## LEon                     -0.021995   0.005114 195.072597  -4.301 2.69e-05 ***
## modalityt1+t2:FSon        0.003863   0.007220 194.818632   0.535   0.5932    
## modalityt1+t2:LEon        0.004626   0.007220 194.818632   0.641   0.5225    
## FSon:LEon                 0.017895   0.007283 194.818932   2.457   0.0149 *  
## modalityt1+t2:FSon:LEon  -0.005538   0.010300 194.818632  -0.538   0.5914    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Correlation of Fixed Effects:
##             (Intr) mdl1+2 FSon   LEon   md1+2:FS m1+2:L FSn:LE
## modltyt1+t2 -0.471                                            
## FSon        -0.466  0.495                                     
## LEon        -0.466  0.495  0.490                              
## mdlty1+2:FS  0.330 -0.701 -0.706 -0.347                       
## mdlty1+2:LE  0.330 -0.701 -0.347 -0.706  0.492                
## FSon:LEon    0.327 -0.348 -0.700 -0.700  0.496    0.496       
## md1+2:FS:LE -0.231  0.491  0.495  0.495 -0.701   -0.701 -0.707

b) Stats report

report(mod1)
## We fitted a linear mixed model (estimated using REML and nloptwrap optimizer)
## to predict avg_roi_E_magn with modality, FS and LE (formula: avg_roi_E_magn ~
## modality * FS * LE). The model included subID as random effect (formula: ~1 |
## subID). The model's total explanatory power is substantial (conditional R2 =
## 0.64) and the part related to the fixed effects alone (marginal R2) is of 0.18.
## The model's intercept, corresponding to modality = t1, FS = off and LE = off,
## is at 0.14 (95% CI [0.13, 0.15], t(222) = 26.50, p < .001). Within this model:
## 
##   - The effect of modality [t1+t2] is statistically non-significant and negative
## (beta = -5.67e-03, 95% CI [-0.02, 4.31e-03], t(222) = -1.12, p = 0.264; Std.
## beta = -0.18, 95% CI [-0.49, 0.13])
##   - The effect of FS [on] is statistically significant and negative (beta =
## -0.03, 95% CI [-0.04, -0.02], t(222) = -6.43, p < .001; Std. beta = -1.03, 95%
## CI [-1.34, -0.71])
##   - The effect of LE [on] is statistically significant and negative (beta =
## -0.02, 95% CI [-0.03, -0.01], t(222) = -4.30, p < .001; Std. beta = -0.69, 95%
## CI [-1.00, -0.37])
##   - The effect of modality [t1+t2] × FS [on] is statistically non-significant and
## positive (beta = 3.86e-03, 95% CI [-0.01, 0.02], t(222) = 0.54, p = 0.593; Std.
## beta = 0.12, 95% CI [-0.32, 0.56])
##   - The effect of modality [t1+t2] × LE [on] is statistically non-significant and
## positive (beta = 4.63e-03, 95% CI [-9.60e-03, 0.02], t(222) = 0.64, p = 0.522;
## Std. beta = 0.14, 95% CI [-0.30, 0.59])
##   - The effect of FS [on] × LE [on] is statistically significant and positive
## (beta = 0.02, 95% CI [3.54e-03, 0.03], t(222) = 2.46, p = 0.015; Std. beta =
## 0.56, 95% CI [0.11, 1.01])
##   - The effect of (modality [t1+t2] × FS [on]) × LE [on] is statistically
## non-significant and negative (beta = -5.54e-03, 95% CI [-0.03, 0.01], t(222) =
## -0.54, p = 0.591; Std. beta = -0.17, 95% CI [-0.81, 0.46])
## 
## Standardized parameters were obtained by fitting the model on a standardized
## version of the dataset. 95% Confidence Intervals (CIs) and p-values were
## computed using a Wald t-distribution approximation.

c) Marginal means

# Get estimated marginal means for all 3 factors
emm_main <- emmeans(mod1, ~ modality * FS * LE)
emm_df   <- as.data.frame(emm_main)

# Plot with FS as color and LE as dodge (side-by-side)
ggplot(emm_df, aes(x = modality, y = emmean, color = FS, group = FS)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ LE, labeller = labeller(LE = c("off" = "Lesion Off", "on" = "Lesion On"))) +
  labs(
    x = "Structural modality",
    y = "Mean |E| (V/m)",
    color = "Freesurfer"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

d) Violin plot

c) marginal means

# Get estimated marginal means for all 3 factors
emm_main <- emmeans(mod3, ~ modality * FS * LE)
emm_df   <- as.data.frame(emm_main)

# Plot with FS as color and LE as dodge (side-by-side)
ggplot(emm_df, aes(x = modality, y = emmean, color = FS, group = FS)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    width = 0.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ LE, labeller = labeller(LE = c("off" = "Lesion Off", "on" = "Lesion On"))) +
  labs(
    x = "Structural modality",
    y = "Mean |E| (V/m)",
    color = "FreeSurfer"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

d) violin plot

# Optional: precompute means per combination
means_df <- sub_data_all.df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(modality, FS, LE) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_E = mean(avg_roi_E_normal, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop_last")

LE_labels <- c(
  "t1" = "T1",
  "t1+t2" = "T1 + T2"
)

ggplot(sub_data_all.df,
       aes(x = LE,
           y = avg_roi_E_normal,
           fill = FS,
           color = FS)) +

  geom_violin(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
              alpha = 0.2,
              width = 0.7) +

  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15,
                                              dodge.width = 0.7),
              size = 1.5,
              alpha = 0.8) +

  geom_point(data = means_df,
             aes(x = LE, y = mean_E, fill = FS),
             shape = 23,
             size = 2.8,
             color = "black",
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +

  facet_wrap(~ modality, labeller = labeller(modality = LE_labels)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
  "on" = "LE On",
  "off" = "LE Off"
)) +
  
    scale_fill_discrete(
    name = "FS",
    labels = c("off" = "Off", "on" = "On")
  ) +
#scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.05, 0.18))+
  labs(x = "",
       y = "Normal component (V/m)",
       fill = "Freesurfer") +
  
  guides(color = "none") +   # remove duplicate legend

  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        #legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),
        legend.position = 'none',
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.justification = c(1, 1),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10))

# Save figure
ggsave("violin_normal.png",
       dpi = 300,
       width = 5.5,
       height = 4,
       units = "in")
